title: Kenya Shilling CBK exchange rates
description: Pick a mode. Every dataset row is one charged result, so a range of all 21 currencies is about 21 rows per business day; maxRows caps the run.

mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Latest / one date (one row per currency)
mode.description: latest: rates for one date (default today; weekends and holidays fall back to the last published day). range: every published business day between two dates. convert: one row converting an amount through KES.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: Leave empty for all 21 currencies CBK publishes. Used by latest and range.

startDate.title: Start date (range)
startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, from 2004-11-02. Required in range mode.

amount.title: Amount (convert)
amount.description: Whole amount to convert, e.g. 1000. Required in convert mode.

fromCurrency.title: From currency (convert)
fromCurrency.description: Currency of the amount (KES or one of the 21). Required in convert mode.

toCurrency.title: To currency (convert)
toCurrency.description: Currency to convert into. Required in convert mode.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Hard cap on rows saved (and charged) in this run.

fetchLatestFromCbk.title: Fetch newest days from CBK
fetchLatestFromCbk.description: Checks CBK for business days newer than the bundled history. Turn off for a fully offline, reproducible run.
